mapper.select: select version , dn_url_adr as updateUrl , title || ':' || up_sbst as updateMsg , must_up_cd from msf_app_version mav where 1=1 and os_cd = #{os} and use_yn = 'Y' order by app_version_seq desc limit 1
mapper.delete: update msf_usr_app_info set apv_sttus_cd = 'C' , bio_login_yn = 'N' , bio_login_token = '' where 1=1 and uuid = #{deviceUuid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO msf_usr_app_info (uuid, mac_adr, user_id, apv_sttus_cd, os_cd, "version", app_os_ver, app_nm, last_access_dt, auto_login_yn, bio_login_yn) VALUES (#{deviceUuid}, #{madAdr}, #{userId}, #{apvSttusCd}, #{osCd}, #{version}, #{appOsVer}, #{appNm}, now(), #{autoLoginYn}, #{bioLoginYn} )
mapper.select: select count(*) from msf_user_info where 1=1 and user_id = #{userId} and user_sttus_cd = 'A'

( select app_version_seq , version , dn_url_adr as updateUrl , title || ':' || up_sbst as updateMsg , must_up_cd , os_cd from msf_app_version mav where 1=1 and use_yn = 'Y' and os_cd = 'I' order by app_version_seq desc limit 1 ) union all ( select app_version_seq , version , dn_url_adr as updateUrl , title || ':' || up_sbst as updateMsg , must_up_cd , os_cd from msf_app_version mav where 1=1 and use_yn = 'Y' and os_cd = 'A' order by app_version_seq desc limit 1 )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO msf_usr_app_token_txn (app_token_seq, user_id, login_div_cd, uuid, "token", token_reg_dt, token_valid_period) VALUES (NEXTVAL('smartform.sq_app_token_seq'), #{userId}, #{osCd}, #{deviceUuid}, #{bioLoginToken}, now(), '');
